description: Use for "what is the evidence" and "which studies": the PubMed studies the atlas cites for a compound, a target, a condition or a compound at one target, each with its PubMed link, what it supports (an effect at a target, a binding value, a caution, a systematic review or a trial as administered) and the atlas record it belongs to, plus the PubMed search behind each record. Doses are left out on purpose. Educational reference, not medical advice.

compound.description: A compound id or name, for example "cbd".

limit.description: How many items to return, at most 50.

name: find_studies
title: Find the studies behind a finding
